content.short: Yearn Subgraph enables querying data from Yearn smart contracts and presents historical returns.
content.description: Yearn Subgraph uses The Graph protocol to fetch data from Yearn smart contracts and aggregate it to display historical returns. It exposes metrics such as vault performance and user balances, empowering developers to analyze Yearn data and observe activity and trends. Developers can connect Yearn Subgraph to their dapps via a GraphQL API endpoint, enabling efficient, on-demand querying of Yearn data for dashboards, analytics, or custom interfaces.
content.meta: Yearn Subgraph stores user data and shows historical returns from Yearn smart contracts. Discover Yearn Subgraph and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
